context: Evaluates the per-session rule: when goals carry a session, the agent reads its own conversation's goal with --session and leaves other conversations' goals alone. Covers Core Rule 1 per session and the --session guidance in the Workflow.

checklist.name: Status run with the session
checklist.description: The agent runs goal.sh status with --session conv-a

checklist.name: Only its own goal reported
checklist.description: The answer covers the conv-a goal and none of the conv-b goal's items

checklist.name: Other goal left alone
checklist.description: The conv-b goal is not closed, promoted or edited

checklist.name: Summary reported verbatim
checklist.description: The rendered summary is reported as printed, not paraphrased
